subject: SparkBridge cohort sponsorship & trial credit qualification
messages:
From: Nina Alvarez <nina@sparkbridge.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-25T15:12:00Z
Subject: Redwood sponsorship ask for Spring '27 cohort

Hi Kimberly —

Quick intro: I run partnerships at SparkBridge, a 12-week accelerator for early-stage infra and developer tooling startups. We're finalizing sponsors for our March cohort and I'd love to discuss a credits sponsorship with Redwood (trial credits + credits-on-completion). Typical ask is around $15k equivalent in inference credits per startup for ~10 startups (pilot cohort).

A few quick details on eligibility we use: companies must be <2 years old, <2M ARR, and building production-facing dev tools or infra. We often ask sponsors to provide a short office hours slot + a small tech talk.

Would Redwood consider a credits + convert-to-dedicated pilot? If helpful I attached a brief cohort pack and cap table.

Best,
Nina Alvarez
Head of Partnerships, SparkBridge
Nina@sparkbridge.com
Attachment: SparkBridge_Cohort_Pack.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Nina Alvarez <nina@sparkbridge.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-26T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood sponsorship ask for Spring '27 cohort

Hi Nina —

Thanks for the note and the packet — this looks like a good fit for our startup program. Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in our credit approvals:
- Are the startups NDA-bound or will we see public demo apps?
- Are there any PII/data residency constraints we should be aware of? (we can support egress rules or VPC for select pilots)
- Confirm timeline: when do you need the credits committed by?

I'll get visibility from Product on whether the month-of-cohort office hours + a 20min tech talk is feasible. If you can send the founder list and a short use-case blurb per company that helps the qualification pass faster.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Head, Startup Programs — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Nina Alvarez <nina@sparkbridge.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-27T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood sponsorship ask for Spring '27 cohort

On Sat, Feb 27, 2027 at 06:04 PM kimberly_park@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks for the note and the packet — this looks like a good fit for our startup program. Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in our credit approvals:
> - Are the startups NDA-bound or will we see public demo apps?
> - Are there any PII/data residency constraints we should be aware of? (we can support egress rules or VPC for select pilots)
> - Confirm timeline: when do you need the credits committed by?

Hi Nina & team —

We can consider a cohort-level allocation but need the following to clear:
1) Founder list + GitHub or public demo links (to validate model usage patterns)
2) Confirmation none of the startups require EU-only data residency (we can support regional allocations but it impacts unit cost)
3) A short success metric — e.g., 3 founders with production integrations within 60 days or a public demo at end-of-cohort

I've attached our quick qualification checklist (redwood-qual-checklist.xlsx) — if you can fill that and return, I'll start a provisional credit request. Typical sponsor structure we approve for similar accelerators is: $10k in hosted credits per company (10 companies) with an option to convert 3 top teams to a Dedicated trial (discounted reserved rate) for 3 months.

Also looping Aditya from Partnerships to help structure the value-exchange (talk + office hours timing) and Rishi for approvals once qualifiers are validated.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-qual-checklist.xlsx
From: Nina Alvarez <nina@sparkbridge.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-01T10:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood sponsorship ask for Spring '27 cohort

Hi Stephanie / Kimberly —

Thanks — attached is the completed checklist plus the founder roster and a short blurb per team. We don't require NDAs for cohort demo days (most demos are public), and none of the companies have EU-only residency needs. A couple notes:
- 2 companies indicated early PII ingestion (hashed emails for auth). They are willing to run on VPC-resident deployments for the pilot if required.
- Timeline: cohort starts 2027-03-14; ideal commitment window is by 2027-03-10 so we can notify founders.

Attachments: sparkbridge_cap_table.csv, SparkBridge_Cohort_Pack.pdf (original), filled_redwood_checklist.xlsx

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 20min sync if that helps.

Best,
Nina
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Nina Alvarez <nina@sparkbridge.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood sponsorship ask for Spring '27 cohort — provisional approval

Kimberly / Stephanie —

Thanks for the materials. Reviewed the filled checklist and founder roster; high-level notes: cohort fits our target profile, only two teams flagged for VPC (we can support). I'm approving a provisional sponsorship: 10x $8k hosted credits (total face $80k footprint) with the option to convert up to 3 teams to a 3-month Dedicated trial (30% reserved discount) conditional on post-cohort milestones (production integration or demo day KPI).

Next steps:
- Stephanie: open a credits request ticket with Billing (include attachments & roster).
- Aditya: coordinate the 20min tech talk slot during week 2 and schedule office hours.
- Kimberly: confirm contract language (standard sponsorship addendum) and get a signed DocuSign by 2027-03-09.

I'll ask Legal to sanity-check T&Cs for the convert-to-dedicated option. Nina — you should receive a DocuSign shortly; once signed we'll mark credits as pending in HubSpot and notify founders.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, BD — Redwood Inference
Attachment: internal-approval-note.txt
